messages:
anna_pm: Quick sync — customer asks: can we support sampled audit evidence exports for SOC2 so they keep only a subset of raw logs for 2 years? Need scope, acceptance criteria, and obvious risks.
sam_security: short answer: yes, but sampling + BYOK complicates chain-of-custody and crypto proofing. we need deterministic sampling seeds and signed manifests.
leo_eng: what does the customer consider a "sample"? random % vs stratified by tenant/action? affects indexes and export size.
chris_cs: they want a 10% sample by default, but with ability to request full export on legal hold. use case: monthly auditors review a representative set.
tina_ops: operationally we can run periodic snapshot jobs, but retention & rehydration for legal hold needs a defined runbook. also cost implications for long-term cold storage.
maya_legal: legal needs guarantees: if a legal hold hits, we must provide all relevant events in the original signed format. sampling cannot preclude full-archive export for legal obligations.
anna_pm: (typo: anna) proposal: MVP = sampled exports (configurable percent + stratification by event type), retention for sampled data = 24 months, full-archive available on-demand via legal hold workflow (SLA TBD).
sam_security: technical acceptance: sampled exports must include a signed manifest containing sampling seed, algorithm, and hashes of each exported chunk. manifests stored in KMS-backed integrity store. will this work with BYOK?
leo_eng: BYOK customers manage keys; we can include manifests encrypted to customer KEK. but verifying hashes requires same keypair or a public verification path. need design doc.
chris_cs: customers will ask: how to prove sample was unbiased? provide auditability: seed + algorithm + signed manifest is fine. also include sampling report with counts by event type.
tina_ops: SLA for full-archive on hold: realistic ETA = 48-72 hours for multi-tenant orgs on cold archive. ops can optimize but must be explicit in launch criteria.
maya_legal: also require retention policy toggles for litigation: ability to pause deletion for specific tenants.
anna_pm: launch criteria checklist (draft): 1) sampling config UI/CLI + API; 2) signed manifest generation and storage; 3) BYOK-compatible manifest encryption; 4) documented legal-hold rehydration runbook + SLA; 5) per-tenant retention toggles; 6) SOC2 evidence playbook updated.
sam_security: add: cryptographic verification tests (unit + integration) and third-party audit checklist.
leo_eng: estimating dev effort: sampling engine + manifest service ~3 sprints, BYOK integration + verification ~2 sprints, UI + runbook ~1 sprint. needs 2 engineers full-time for 6 weeks + infra changes.
chris_cs: prioritize customers with active compliance deals first — we can pilot with 1-2 customers to validate.
tina_ops: ops checklist: tagging export jobs, monitoring queue, budget alarm when export volumes exceed X TB/month, rehydration playbook docs.
maya_legal: question: if customer-managed keys are rotated/compromised, how do we preserve historical manifests? require key rotation policy + escrow option.
leo_eng: we can retain a verification public key per customer alongside encrypted manifests so history stays verifiable even after rotation. need legal signoff.
anna_pm: risks: (1) misunderstanding around "sampled" vs "complete" during sales; (2) BYOK edge-cases; (3) cost surprises for rehydration. mitigation: clear marketing + contract language, pilot, and explicit SLAs.
chris_cs: agree — add contract clause: sampled exports are representative; full-archive available on legal hold within SLA; additional fees may apply for expedited retrieval.
sam_security: action items: sam -> write manifest spec (crypto, fields, seed derivation), leo -> initial system design, maya -> legal hold contract language draft.
leo_eng: pinging evidence-bot to simulate export flow: `evidence-bot: simulated export job started for tenant: acme-inc, sample_pct=10`
evidence-bot: export job 8732 started, seed=0x5f2a3b, manifest_id=mf-20231201-8732 (simulated) :white_check_mark:
anna_pm: ok let's aim for pilot alpha in 6 weeks. i'll sync with sales to pick pilot customers. thanks all. :thumbsup:
